messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Flonase is a nasal spray containing fluticasone propionate.
Fluticasone propionate is a corticosteroid that reduces inflammation in the lining of the nose.
Flonase Nasal Spray is used to treat nasal congestion, sneezing, runny nose, and itchy or watery eyes.
These symptoms are caused by seasonal or year-round allergies.
Flonase Allergy Relief is for use in adults and children who are at least 4 years old.
It is available without a prescription.
Children's Flonase Allergy Relief contains the same medicine.
It is also for ages 4 and older.
Flonase Sensimist contains fluticasone furoate rather than fluticasone propionate.
It is approved for use in adults and children 2 years of age and older.
Children's Flonase Sensimist is also for ages 2 and older.
In Flonase Sensimist labeling, relief of itchy, watery eyes applies to ages 12 and older.
The brand-name prescription version of Flonase nasal spray has been discontinued in the United States.
Generic fluticasone propionate nasal spray is still available by prescription.
Triplet: ["Children's Flonase Allergy Relief", "contains same medicine as", "Flonase Allergy Relief"]

The relation 'contains same medicine as' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject product includes the same active ingredient or medication as the object product.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
B. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
C. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
E. 'may be prescribed with': The subject drug may be prescribed in combination with the medication specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
